issues.problem: 开头第一次出现梅洛尼时，没有交代她是谁、与这件事有什么关系。她的身份要到 story.6 才说明。皮埃尔·居里与居里夫人是夫妻，hook 里也没有点明。读者读完开头说不清是谁在募捐。

evidence.quote: It was my hope when I arrived in New York, a few weeks afterwards, to find ten women to subscribe ten thousand dollars each

issues.proposed: zh 改为“是她和丈夫皮埃尔·居里多年前……；后来为本书写引言的梅洛尼在美国发起募捐……”。en 改为“by Marie Curie and her husband Pierre Curie … and Meloney, who later wrote the book's introduction, set out to raise a subscription…”。

issues.problem: 导语直接写“梅洛尼探访时”/“When Meloney visited”，没有说明梅洛尼是谁，读者不知道这个人物在事件中的角色。
issues.proposed: zh 改为“1921年赠镭之前，后来为本书写引言的梅洛尼去探访时……”。en 改为“When Meloney, who later wrote the book's introduction, visited…”。

issues.problem: en 写有“some help from outside sources”，zh 只写“后来才得到少量补助”，漏掉了外部帮助这一项。

evidence.quote: later we were given a few subventions and some help from outside sources

issues.proposed: zh 改为“后来才得到少量补助和一些外部帮助”。

issues.problem: “想把一种新放射性物质提纯到能确认是新元素”/“wanted to purify … far enough to be sure it was a new element”把一个证据没有写出的目标当作事实。证据写的是：他们相信镭和部分钋在残渣里；化学工作的目标是制备纯镭盐。

evidence.quote: We believed that we would find all the radium and a part of the polonium in the residues of this mine
had as their objective the preparation of pure radium salts

issues.proposed: zh 改为“居里夫妇要从矿石里提取镭和钋”。en 改为“The Curies were trying to extract radium and polonium from ore”。

issues.problem: en 写有“without any interior arrangements”，zh 漏掉了，只写“里面只有……”。

evidence.quote: a glass roof which did not keep the rain out, and without any interior arrangements

issues.proposed: zh 在“玻璃屋顶挡不住雨”后补“里面没有任何设施”。

issues.problem: en 写有庞加莱“anxious to free him from the necessity of quitting France”，zh 删去了。这一点正是拒绝日内瓦与在索邦获聘之间的联系。

evidence.quote: who was anxious to free him from the necessity of quitting France

issues.proposed: zh 改为“他申请后，在一心想让他不必离开法国的庞加莱的影响下获聘”。

issues.problem: 稿件用“同时/Meanwhile……1899年”，把工业试验写成与索邦新职的场地困难同时发生。原文作“As early as 1899”，表示这次试验更早。

evidence.quote: As early as 1899 Pierre Curie succeeded in organizing a first industrial experiment
And besides these difficulties

issues.proposed: zh 改为“除了这些困难，没有工业手段处理原料，研究也推不动。早在1899年，皮埃尔就……”。en 改为“Besides these difficulties… As early as 1899 Pierre Curie organized…”。

issues.problem: en 写了两项事实，zh 都漏掉了：该公司因皮埃尔制造天平与他有往来；试验取得了良好结果。

evidence.quote: with which he had had relations in connection with the construction of his balances
the operations brought good results

issues.proposed: zh 改为“借中央化学产品公司（他因制造天平与之有往来）的一处现成设施……技术细节由德比埃尔纳安排得很成功，试验效果良好”。

issues.problem: zh 写明附属楼属于索邦，en 只写“the annex at 12 rue Cuvier”，漏掉了 of the Sorbonne。

evidence.quote: in the annex (12 rue Cuvier) of the Sorbonne

issues.proposed: en 改为“In the annex of the Sorbonne at 12 rue Cuvier…”。

issues.problem: en 保留了两点，zh 都删去了：办厂之举在当时看来很大胆；医生的兴趣是由各种研究的发表引起的。

evidence.quote: which seemed daring at that epoch
had been aroused by the publication of various investigations

issues.proposed: zh 改为“办起一座在当时看来很大胆的真正镭工厂……医生们因各种研究的发表，已对镭的生物效应和可能的疗法产生兴趣”。

issues.problem: zh 把“most important”写成“最大的一笔”，意思变了，也和 en 不一致。

evidence.quote: of which the most important, accorded in 1902 by the Academy of Sciences, amounted to 20,000 francs

issues.proposed: zh 改为“最重要的一笔是1902年科学院给的两万法郎”。

issues.problem: en 写了她要当晚办好文件的另一层理由“I might die tomorrow. Too much is at stake.”，zh 只写“因为第二天就要接收镭”，漏掉了这一层。

issues.proposed: zh 改为“她要求当晚就把文件办好：第二天就要接收镭，而她可能明天就死，事关重大（据梅洛尼转述）”。

issues.proposed: zh 改为“作者认为，差别不在谁更高尚，而在谁承担风险”。en 改为“In the author's view, the difference is not who is nobler…”。

issues.proposed: zh 改为“本篇的史实全部出自同一本书”。en 改为“Every historical fact in this piece comes from one book”。
